title: Communication Mandate
nlang_code:
mod blocks CommunicationMandate {
  props {
    id: str,
    #[optional(true)]
    delegation_mandate_id: str,
    human_principal_did: str,
    agent_did: str,
    channel_kind: str,
    recipient_addressing: Positional,
    content_class: str,
    body_sha256: str,
    body_size: u64,
    policy_decision: str,
    issued_at: str,
    expires_at: str,
    notary_signature: str,
  }
}
note: Single-use authority for one message. `delegation_mandate_id` is absent for a one-shot AskEveryTime decision, where the human approved this send directly and no standing authority exists. The principal and agent DIDs are restated rather than only referenced, so a verifier can detect a mandate re-pointed at a different parent. A five-minute `expires_at` is recommended.
